items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.title: Show HN: Reviving a 2012 open-source password manager for modern Android
items.contentSnippet:
Offline password manager for Android: a fork of Passdroid (last release 2012), brought up to date. The app has no internet permission.
Two key new features:
- 2FA codes (TOTP)
- fingerprint unlock
Plus many smaller changes and fixes, and security hardening: AES-256 with PBKDF2 at 600k iterations, AES-GCM encrypted exports. Threat model and design are in INTERNALS.md.
Built largely with Claude Code; the design and security decisions are mine.
Feedback welcome, especially on the security side.

items.title: Show HN: A playable world model of the Backrooms
items.contentSnippet:
A 211M-param transformer acts as a game engine. It draws every next frame from the last 2.4 seconds and my inputs.
Built a simulator of 18 Backrooms levels in PyTorch to generate the data.
Recorded 440 hours of scripted play in it.
Trained the model from scratch on that, using flow matching in a pretrained autoencoder's latent space.
The model was trained on its own imperfect frames as context so it doesn't drift right away. It recalls a few older frames by position, so a quick look back usually

items.contentSnippet:
I made Quadrivia, a trivia game covering science, math, logic, nature, geography, and philosophy.
I had the idea about ten years ago. I like trivia, but I don't know much about pop culture, so I wanted a game built for subjects I enjoy. I started writing down questions in my phone's Notes app and reading them to my friends. That eventually became this app.
